summary: Section C is factually tight against its citations: the Marcovina 2007 ADA Workgroup figures (12 methods / 9 manufacturers / 39 specimens; CV 12–66% median 24%; cross-reactivity <2% / <3% / >40% for the three proinsulin species; common reference preparation ineffective) were verified against the published paper, and all type tags are correctly applied (cohort for comparative analytical studies, regulatory for the IFCC/Thienpont standards-body status report, mechanism_review for the IDE-hemolysis and LC-MS/MS RMP papers). Every source is whitelisted Tier 1 or Tier 2 (ifcc.org now Tier 2 per whitelist); no bare [N] citations; the ~71% RCV is mathematically consistent with EuBIVAS CVI 25.3% at CVA ~5%; mechanistic reasoning (IDE release, sandwich-epitope destruction, B-chain epitope retention by des-64,65) is correct throughout.
